title: A thin piece of Junk. Don't waste your money.
text:
A thin piece of Junk. Don't waste your money.. I have allot of the older Calphalon Commercial cookware, and Simply, Contemporary, and some new pieces of the Calphalon Unison.
Unison slid's on my heavy gas grates!!
I'm very familiar with Calphalon, and its Not what it use to be at all!

The Simply is made in China, and the Unison, and Commercial is made in the USA, I think Ill.
I returned my Calphalon commercial roaster after a few years (life time warrantee) as it did not hold up very good, and this is what Calphalon sent me in its place!
Needless to say, This is a Thin piece of Junk compared to what I returned.
Its light weigh does not live up to what Calphalon use to be.
The only good thing I can say about the new Calphalon is, I like the new handles! But not enough to buy them!

I'm So Disgusted with this thin lite weight Roaster and other new pieces, I will Not be buying anymore Calphalon any longer.

product_metadata.title: Simply Calphalon Nonstick Collector's Edition 16-Inch Roaster with Rack
features: Nonstick rack with handles holds food off bottom for uniform browning
Mid-weight, mid-priced alternative to Calphalon's top-grade lines
Anodized aluminum for hardness, with nonstick coating inside; satin-finish, stay-cool, stainless-steel handles
Oven-safe to 375 degrees F; safe with nylon, wood, plastic utensils; hand-washing recommended
description: A midweight, midpriced alternative to Calphalon's Professional and Commercial nonstick cookware, the Simply Calphalon Nonstick Anodized line is made of hard-anodized aluminum for scratch resistance and quick, uniform heating. It's harder than steel and won't chip, crack, or peel. Inside, the cookware is coated with nonstick for low-fat (or nonfat) cooking and easy food release. Handles are made of contemporary satin-finish stainless steel and stay cool on the stovetop. The two handles on this 16-by-12-inch roasting pan, which is large enough to hold a 19- to 25-pound turkey, two chickens, or a massive prime rib, are roomy enough to accommodate oven mitts. Accompanying the pan is a nonstick rack with handles of its own to lift food off the pan's bottom for all-around roasting and browning. The pan is also great for baking a lasagna or a big cake. It's safe with nylon, wood, and plastic utensils and should be hand washed to preserve the nonstick finish.
